en.t: Julius Caesar dedicates a temple to Venus Genetrix, fulfilling a vow he made at the Battle of Pharsalus
en.s: Gaius Julius Caesar (12 or 13 July 100 BC – 15 March 44 BC) was a Roman general, statesman, and author who was the dictator of the Roman Republic almost continuously from 49 BC until his assassination in 44 BC. A member of the First Triumvirate, he led the Roman armies through the Gallic Wars and defeated his political rival Pompey in Caesar's civil war.

zh.t: 尤利乌斯·恺撒为维纳斯·根涅特里克丝神庙举行奉献仪式
zh.s: 盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·恺撒（公元前100年7月12日或13日—公元前44年3月15日）是罗马将军、政治家和作家，公元前49年至遇刺前几乎一直担任罗马共和国独裁官。他是第一三头同盟成员，率军参加高卢战争，并在恺撒内战中击败政治对手庞培。

en.s: The Battle of Compiègne was fought on 26 September 715 and was the first definite battle of the civil war which followed the death of Pepin of Heristal, Duke of the Franks, on 16 December 714. Dagobert III had appointed one Ragenfrid as mayor of the palace in opposition to Pepin's choice as his successor: his grandson Theudoald.

zh.s: 贡比涅战役于715年9月26日爆发，是丕平·赫斯塔尔公爵于714年12月16日去世后引发的内战中，首场有明确记载的战役。丕平三世曾指定其孙子提奥阿尔德为继承人，但达戈贝尔三世任命拉根弗雷德为宫相，与这一安排相对立。

en.t: William II is crowned King of England, and reigns until 1100
en.s: William II (Anglo-Norman: Williame; c. 1057 – 2 August 1100) was King of England from 26 September 1087 until his death in 1100, with powers over Normandy and influence in Scotland. He was less successful in extending his control into Wales. The third son of William the Conqueror, he is commonly referred to as William Rufus (Rufus being Latin for "the Red"), perhaps because of his ruddy appearance or, more likely, because he had red hair.

zh.t: 威廉二世加冕为英格兰国王，在位至1100年
zh.s: 威廉二世自1087年9月26日起统治英格兰，直至1100年去世，同时掌控诺曼底并对苏格兰拥有影响力；他未能成功扩大在威尔士的势力。他是征服者威廉的第三个儿子，通常被称为“红王威廉”（Rufus在拉丁语中意为“红色”），这个称呼可能源于他的红润肤色，更可能是因为他有一头红发。

en.t: Stephen of Blois's army approaches Oxford, beginning the siege of Oxford
en.s: Stephen (1092 or 1096 – 25 October 1154), often referred to as Stephen of Blois, was King of England from 22 December 1135 to his death in 1154. He was Count of Boulogne jure uxoris from 1125 until 1147 and Duke of Normandy from 1135 until 1144. His reign was marked by the Anarchy, a civil war with his cousin and rival, the Empress Matilda, whose son, Henry II, succeeded Stephen as the first of the Angevin kings of England.

zh.t: 布卢瓦的斯蒂芬率军抵达牛津，牛津围城战开始
zh.s: 斯蒂芬（1092年或1096年—1154年10月25日），常称布卢瓦的斯蒂芬，自1135年12月22日起担任英格兰国王，直至1154年去世。1125年至1147年，他因婚姻权利兼任布洛涅伯爵，1135年至1144年任诺曼底公爵。他在位期间爆发无政府时期，即与表亲兼对手玛蒂尔达女皇之间的内战；玛蒂尔达之子亨利二世后来成为首位安茹王朝英格兰国王。

en.s: The Battle of Staveren, also known as the Battle of Warns (West Frisian: Slach by Warns; Dutch: Slag bij Warns), was a battle of the Friso-Hollandic Wars between Count William IV of Holland and the Frisians which took place on 26 September 1345. The annual commemoration of the battle is important for many nationalist Frisians. The Frisians won the battle and repelled the 'Hollanders' from the eastern coast of the Zuiderzee.

zh.s: 斯塔弗伦战役又称瓦恩斯战役（西弗里斯兰语：Slach by Warns；荷兰语：Slag bij Warns），是弗里斯兰—荷兰战争中的一场战役，于1345年9月26日爆发。荷兰伯爵威廉四世与弗里斯人交战。许多弗里斯民族主义者每年都会纪念这场战役。弗里斯人获胜，并将“荷兰人”赶出须德海东岸。

en.s: The Battle of Maritsa, also known as the Battle of Chernomen (Serbian: Marička bitka / Маричка битка; Turkish: Çirmen Muharebesi, İkinci Meriç Muharebesi; "Second Battle of Maritsa"), was fought on 26 September 1371 near the Maritsa River, close to the village of Chernomen (present-day Ormenio, Greece). The conflict pitted the Ottoman forces under Lala Şahin Pasha and Hacı İlbey against a coalition of Serbian lords, led by King Vukašin Mrnjavčević and his brother Despot Jovan Uglješa who sought to halt the Ottomans' westward advance.

zh.s: 马里查河战役又称切尔诺门战役（塞尔维亚语：Marička bitka／Маричка битка；土耳其语：Çirmen Muharebesi、İkinci Meriç Muharebesi，意为“第二次马里查河战役”），于1371年9月26日在马里查河附近、今希腊奥尔梅尼奥村附近爆发。拉拉·沙欣帕夏和哈吉·伊尔贝伊率领的奥斯曼军队与塞尔维亚领主联军交战，后者由国王武卡辛·姆尔尼亚夫切维奇及其弟、专制公爵约万·乌格列沙率领，试图阻止奥斯曼向西扩张。

en.s: The Battle of La Brossinière or Battle of la Gravelle (French - la "besoigne" de la Brossinière) was a battle of the Hundred Years' War on 26 September 1423. It occurred at La Brossinière (commune of Bourgon, Mayenne), between the forces of England and France, shortly after hostilities had resumed, following the battle of Agincourt (1415). The English force commanded by Sir John De la Pole, brother of William de la Pole, Earl of Suffolk, which had returned to Normandy after a pillaging expedition to Anjou and Maine, suffered a crushing defeat.

zh.s: 拉布罗西尼埃战役又称拉格拉维尔战役，于1423年9月26日百年战争期间爆发，地点在法国马耶讷省布尔贡市镇的拉布罗西尼埃。英法两军在阿金库尔战役（1415年）后重新开战不久便于此交锋。约翰·德拉波尔爵士率领的英军刚结束对安茹和曼恩的劫掠、返回诺曼底，结果遭遇惨败。

en.s: The action of 26 September 1575 was a naval battle on 26 September 1575 near the coasts of Catalonia, when 3 Algerian vessels fought with a Spanish galley and captured it, taking the famous Spanish writer, Miguel de Cervantes, as a prisoner. During the first week of September 1575, Miguel de Cervantes embarked on a Spanish galley named El Sol with his younger brother, Rodrigo, who both fought at the Battle of Lepanto.

zh.s: 1575年9月26日，阿尔及利亚3艘船只在加泰罗尼亚海岸附近与一艘西班牙桨帆船交战并将其俘获，著名西班牙作家米格尔·德·塞万提斯也被抓为俘虏。1575年9月第一周，塞万提斯与弟弟罗德里戈登上名为“太阳号”的西班牙桨帆船；两人此前都曾参加勒班陀战役。

en.s: The English explorer Francis Drake circumnavigated the Earth between 13 December 1577 and 26 September 1580. The expedition was authorised by Queen Elizabeth I and consisted of five ships. Termed a 'voyage of discovery', it was in effect an ambitious covert raiding voyage and the start of England's challenge to the global domination of Spain and Portugal. Drake set off on 15 December 1577 after a delay of nearly six months.

zh.t: 弗朗西斯·德雷克环球航行
zh.s: 英国探险家弗朗西斯·德雷克于1577年12月13日至1580年9月26日完成环球航行。伊丽莎白一世女王授权了这次远征，共有5艘船参加。虽然名为“发现之旅”，实际上这是一场规模宏大的秘密袭击行动，也开启了英格兰挑战西班牙和葡萄牙全球霸权的进程。德雷克因延误近6个月，于1577年12月15日启航。

en.s: The Ottoman–Safavid war of 1603–1612 consisted of two wars between Safavid Iran under Shah Abbas I and the Ottoman Empire under Mehmed III and his son Ahmed I. The first war began in 1603 and ended with a Safavid victory in 1612, when they regained and reestablished their suzerainty over the Caucasus and Western Iran, which had been lost at the Treaty of Constantinople in 1590.

zh.s: 1603年至1612年的奥斯曼—萨法维战争由两场战争组成。萨法维伊朗在阿拔斯一世统治下，与穆罕默德三世及其子艾哈迈德一世统治下的奥斯曼帝国交战。第一场战争于1603年爆发，1612年以萨法维获胜告终；萨法维重新收复并恢复了对高加索和伊朗西部的宗主权，这些地区此前于1590年《君士坦丁堡条约》中割让。

en.s: The Uskok War, also known as the War of Gradisca or the War of Friuli, was fought by the Austrians, Slovenes, Croats (from Croatia and Slavonia) and Spanish on one side and the Venetians, Croats (from Dalmatia and Istria), Slovenes (from Istria), Dutch, and English on the other. It is named for the Uskoks, soldiers from Croatia used by the Austrians for irregular warfare.

zh.s: 乌斯科克战争又称格拉迪斯卡战争或弗留利战争，交战双方包括奥地利人、斯洛文尼亚人、克罗地亚人（来自克罗地亚和斯拉沃尼亚）及西班牙人，以及威尼斯人、克罗地亚人（来自达尔马提亚和伊斯特拉）、斯洛文尼亚人（来自伊斯特拉）、荷兰人和英国人。战争以乌斯科克人命名，他们是奥地利用于非正规作战的克罗地亚士兵。

en.s: The Ottoman–Safavid War of 1616–1618 was a brief war between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Iran. After the Ottoman–Safavid war (1603–1612), the Ottomans and Safavids had signed the Treaty of Nasuh Pasha, in which their borders were changed back to the previous one under Selim I and Shah Ismail I. In exchange, the Safavid ruler Shah Abbas I promised to send the Ottomans 200 pack-loads of silk each year.

zh.s: 1616年至1618年的奥斯曼—萨法维战争是奥斯曼帝国与萨法维伊朗之间的一场短暂战争。此前，双方于1603年至1612年交战；战后签订《纳苏帕夏条约》，将边界恢复到塞利姆一世和沙阿·伊斯玛仪一世时期的旧界。作为交换，萨法维统治者阿拔斯一世承诺每年向奥斯曼帝国进贡200驮丝绸。

en.t: Morean War: The Parthenon in Athens, used as a gunpowder depot by the Ottoman garrison, is partially destroyed after being bombarded during the Siege of the Acropolis by Venetian forces
en.s: The Morean war (Italian: Guerra di Morea), also known as the Sixth Ottoman–Venetian War, was fought between 1684–1699 as part of the wider conflict known as the "Great Turkish War", between the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire. Military operations ranged from Dalmatia to the Aegean Sea, but the war's major campaign was the Venetian conquest of the Morea (Peloponnese) peninsula in southern Greece.

zh.t: 摩里亚战争：威尼斯军队围攻卫城期间，奥斯曼守军将雅典帕特农神庙用作火药库，神庙遭炮击后部分损毁
zh.s: 摩里亚战争（意大利语：Guerra di Morea）又称第六次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争，于1684年至1699年间进行，是更广泛的“大土耳其战争”的一部分，交战双方为威尼斯共和国和奥斯曼帝国。军事行动从达尔马提亚延伸至爱琴海，但战争的主要战役是威尼斯征服希腊南部的摩里亚（伯罗奔尼撒）半岛。

en.s: The Battle of Fatehpur Sikri occurred near Fatehpur Sikri on 26 September 1721 between Mughal forces and those of the Jats. 10,000 Mughal forces were led by Nilkanth (the deputy governor of Agra) against 6,000 soldiers led by Muhkam Singh Sinsinwar of Thun and Shardul Singh of Pathena. Nilkanth was killed during the battle, ultimately a failed attempt by the Mughal to re-establish themselves.

zh.t: 法塔赫布尔西格里战役
zh.s: 法塔赫布尔西格里战役于1721年9月26日在法塔赫布尔西格里附近爆发，交战双方是莫卧儿军队和贾特人。阿格拉副总督尼尔坎特率领1万名莫卧儿士兵，对阵由通的穆赫卡姆·辛格·辛辛瓦尔和帕特赫纳的沙杜尔·辛格率领的6000名士兵。尼尔坎特在战斗中阵亡，莫卧儿试图重建统治的行动最终失败。

en.s: The battle of Nuwakot also called siege of Nuwakot or invasion of Nuwakot was fought in Nuwakot in 1744. Nuwakot was controlled by the Kingdom of Kantipur and it was an important location as it had a trade route to Tibet. The Gorkha Kingdom previously attacked twice by Nara Bhupal Shah and his son Prithvi Narayan Shah respectively. To prepare for the war Prithvi Narayan Shah visited Varanasi to get war materials, ammunition, acquire weapons, train the soldiers, and Pilgrims. He improved his army personnel and included people from any caste including the blacksmiths, cobblers, sweepers, Damai, and anyone who was bodied and physically fit was able to join the crew. The Gorkha Kingdom attacked Nuwakot on 26 September 1744 as astrologer Kulananda Dhakal said it was the auspicious day for launching the attack.

zh.s: 努瓦科特战役又称努瓦科特围城战或入侵努瓦科特，1744年在努瓦科特发生。努瓦科特由坎提普尔王国控制，是通往西藏的贸易路线要地。戈尔卡王国曾先后两次遭纳拉·布帕尔·沙阿和其子普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿进攻。为备战，普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿前往瓦拉纳西采购军需和武器、训练士兵并招募朝圣者；他扩充军队，向各个种姓开放，铁匠、鞋匠、清道夫、达迈族以及任何体格健壮者都可入伍。占星师库拉南达·达卡尔称1744年9月26日是出兵吉日，戈尔卡王国遂于当天进攻努瓦科特。

en.s: Yengišan (Manchu: ᠶᡝᠨᡤᡳᡧᠠᠨ, romanized: yengišan; Chinese: 尹繼善; 21 May 1695 – 4 June 1771) was a Manchu official of the Qing dynasty, who was part of the Bordered Yellow Banner. He served various official positions during the Qing dynasty. His father is Yentai (尹泰).

zh.s: 尹继善（满语：ᠶᡝᠨᡤᡳᡧᠠᠨ，转写：yengišan；汉语：尹繼善；1695年5月21日—1771年6月4日）是清朝官员，隶属镶黄旗，曾在清朝担任多个官职。其父为尹泰。

en.s: The Battle of Tornow was fought between the forces of Prussia and Sweden on 26 September 1758 during the Seven Years' War, near modern-day Fürstenberg/Havel (then called Tornow, in the Grand Duchy of Mecklenburg-Strelitz). The Prussians sent 6,000 men, led by general Wedel, to protect Berlin. Wedel attacked aggressively and ordered his cavalry to attack a Swedish force of some 600 men at Tornow. The Swedes bravely fought off six assaults, but the majority of the Swedish cavalry was lost, and the Swedish infantry had to retreat before the stronger Prussian forces. The Prussian-Swedish battles continued at the Battle of Fehrbellin on 28 September 1758.

zh.s: 托尔诺战役于1758年9月26日七年战争期间爆发，交战双方是普鲁士和瑞典军队，地点在今德国菲尔斯滕贝格／哈弗尔附近（当时称托尔诺，属梅克伦堡-施特雷利茨大公国）。韦德尔将军率领6000名普军保卫柏林，并下令骑兵进攻托尔诺约600名瑞典军。瑞典军顽强挡住了6次冲锋，但大部分瑞典骑兵损失，步兵也被优势普军迫退。普瑞双方随后于1758年9月28日在费尔贝林再次交战。

en.s: The Battle of Kathmandu (Nepali: काठमाडौंको युद्ध) or siege of Kathmandu or siege of Kantipur occurred during the Unification of Nepal. It was fought in Kathmandu in 1768, and resulted in the defeat of its king Jaya Prakash Malla by conquerors Prithvi Narayan Shah, king of the adjoining Gorkha Kingdom. Shah's victory marked the establishment of the Shah dynasty in Nepal and the end of the rule of the indigenous Newars.

zh.s: 加德满都战役（尼泊尔语：काठमाडौंको युद्ध）又称加德满都围城战或坎提普尔围城战，发生于尼泊尔统一战争期间。1768年，邻近戈尔卡王国国王普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿攻打加德满都，击败了当地国王贾亚·普拉卡什·马拉。沙阿获胜后，沙阿王朝在尼泊尔建立，原住民纽瓦尔人的统治告终。

en.t: American Revolutionary War: British troops capture and begin the occupation of Philadelphia, which had been serving as the American capital city, during the Philadelphia campaign
en.s: The American Revolutionary War (April 19, 1775 – September 3, 1783), also known as the Revolutionary War or American War of Independence or simply the American Revolution, was the armed conflict that comprised the final eight years of the broader American Revolution, in which American Patriot forces organized as the Continental Army and, commanded by George Washington, defeated the British Army.

zh.t: 美国独立战争：英军攻占并开始占领费城
zh.s: 美国独立战争（1775年4月19日—1783年9月3日）也称革命战争或美国独立战争，是更广泛美国革命最后8年中的武装冲突。乔治·华盛顿指挥的爱国者军队组成大陆军，最终击败英国陆军。

en.s: The Battle of Charlotte was an American Revolutionary War battle fought in Charlotte, North Carolina on September 26, 1780. The battle took place at the Mecklenburg County Court House, which is now the site of the Bank of America tower at Trade and Tryon Streets in downtown Charlotte. An advance guard of General Charles Cornwallis' army rode into town and encountered a well-prepared Patriot militia under the command of William R. Davie in front of the court house. A skirmish ensued in which George Hanger, leading the British cavalry, was wounded.

zh.s: 夏洛特战役是美国独立战争期间的一场战斗，于1780年9月26日在北卡罗来纳州夏洛特爆发，战场位于梅克伦堡县法院旧址（如今是夏洛特市中心特雷德街与特赖恩街交汇处的美国银行大厦所在地）。查尔斯·康沃利斯将军的前锋骑兵进入城镇后，在法院前遭遇威廉·R. 戴维率领、已有准备的爱国者民兵。双方随即交战，率领英军骑兵的乔治·汉格受伤。

zh.s: 《Abbey Road》是英国摇滚乐队披头士的第十一张录音室专辑，由苹果唱片于1969年9月26日发行。这是乐队实际录制的最后一张专辑；《Let It Be》虽然更早录制，但因制作问题延后发行。《Abbey Road》主要录制于1969年4月、7月和8月，并登上美国和英国唱片榜榜首。

en.s: Operation Counterpunch, waged 26 September 1970 to 7 January 1971, was a military offensive of the Laotian Civil War. Royalist General Vang Pao's guerrilla army regained the vital all-weather forward fighter base at Muang Soui on the Plain of Jars from the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN). The preemptive Counterpunch was credited with delaying an imminent PAVN wet season offensive for a month.

en.s: Air Caribbean Flight 309 was a domestic, non-scheduled airline flight by Puerto Rican airline Air Caribbean, which on Tuesday, September 26th, 1978, crashed as it was preparing to land at Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport (then known, unofficially, as Isla Verde International Airport) in San Juan, after a flight from Ramey Air Force Base (what is now known as Rafael Hernandez Airport) in Aguadilla, killing all six occupants of the aircraft and injuring several customers of a Barrio Obrero bar into which the airplane fell.

zh.s: 波多黎各加勒比航空309号班机是一趟国内非定期航班。1978年9月26日星期二，飞机从阿瓜迪亚的拉米空军基地（现拉斐尔·埃尔南德斯机场）起飞，准备降落在圣胡安的路易斯·穆尼奥斯·马林国际机场（当时非正式称为伊斯拉·韦尔德国际机场）时坠毁。机上6人全部遇难，飞机落入巴里奥奥夫雷罗区一家酒吧，造成数名顾客受伤。

en.s: The Oktoberfest bombing (German: Oktoberfest-Attentat) was a far-right terrorist attack. On 26 September 1980, 13 people were killed (including the perpetrator) and more than 200 injured by the explosion of an improvised explosive device (IED) at the main entrance of the Oktoberfest festival in Munich, West Germany. The bombing was attributed to the right-wing extremist and geology student Gundolf Köhler, who was instantly killed in the attack as the bomb exploded prematurely. Prior to the bombing, Köhler had been involved with the banned neo-Nazi militia Wehrsportgruppe Hoffmann, and doubts remain as to whether he acted alone.

zh.s: 1980年9月26日，极右翼恐怖袭击者在西德慕尼黑啤酒节主入口引爆自制爆炸装置，造成13人死亡（包括袭击者本人），200多人受伤。炸弹提前爆炸，极右翼分子、地质学专业学生贡多尔夫·克勒也在袭击中当场死亡。爆炸案被归咎于克勒。他曾参与被禁的新纳粹民兵组织霍夫曼体育团，至今仍有人质疑他是否单独作案。

en.s: Operation Alborz (Persian: عملیات البرز), more commonly known by the code-name Operation Kaman 99 (عملیات کمان 99), was an operation launched by the Iranian Air Force in retaliation to Iraqi surprise aerial attacks on Iran the day before which marked the beginning of the 8-year-long Iran–Iraq War. Involving nearly 200 aircraft (of which more than 140 crossed into Iraq), it is considered the largest operation carried out by the IRIAF.

en.s: Soccer Bowl '81 was the championship final of the 1981 NASL season, between the Chicago Sting and the New York Cosmos. The match was played on September 26, 1981, at Exhibition Stadium, in Toronto, Ontario. Following regulation and 15 minutes of golden goal overtime, the match remained tied, 0–0. With that, the game moved to a shoot-out. The Sting won the shoot-out, 2–1, and were crowned the 1981 NASL champions.

en.s: The 1982 Hessian state election was held on 26 September 1982 to elect the 10th Landtag of Hesse. The outgoing government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and Free Democratic Party (FDP) led by Minister-President Holger Börner. The election produced an inconclusive result, with neither the SPD nor the opposition Christian Democratic Union (CDU) achieving a majority.

en.s: Soyuz 7K-ST No.16L, sometimes known as Soyuz T-10a or Soyuz T-10-1, was an unsuccessful Soyuz mission intended to visit the Salyut 7 space station, which was occupied by the Soyuz T-9 crew. However, it never finished its launch countdown; the launch vehicle was destroyed on the launch pad by fire on 26 September 1983. The launch escape system of the Soyuz spacecraft fired six seconds before the launch vehicle exploded, saving the crew.

en.s: The 1985 Hong Kong legislative election was an indirect election for members of the Legislative Council of Hong Kong (LegCo) held on 26 September 1985. It was the first ever election of the Legislative Council in Hong Kong which marked the beginning of the Hong Kong representative democracy. After the Sino-British Joint Declaration, the Hong Kong government decided to start the process of democratisation in Hong Kong based on the consultative document Green Paper: the Further Development of Representative Government in Hong Kong published on 18 July 1984.

zh.s: 香港于1985年9月26日间接选举立法局议员。这是香港立法局首次举行选举，开启了香港代议制民主进程。中英联合声明签署后，港府决定依据1984年7月18日发布的咨询文件《代议制政府的进一步发展绿皮书》，启动香港民主化进程。

en.s: The Oka Crisis (French: Crise d'Oka), also known as the Mohawk Crisis or Kanehsatà:ke Resistance (French: Résistance de Kanehsatà:ke), was a land dispute between a group of Mohawk people and the town of Oka, Quebec, Canada, over plans to build a golf course on land known as "The Pines" which included an Indigenous burial ground. en.s: On 26 September 1992, a Nigerian Air Force Lockheed C-130H Hercules crashed three minutes after take-off from Lagos, Nigeria. All 159 people on board were killed, including 8 foreign nationals. The aircraft was taking off at high weight and three of its four engines failed. A total of 151 Nigerians, 5 Ghanaians, 1 Tanzanian, 1 Zimbabwean, and 1 Ugandan military officers were confirmed to have died. This is the deadliest crash of a C-130 Hercules aircraft. The accident was also one of the factors leading to the hijacking of Nigeria Airways a year later, with the hijackers demanding a reinvestigation into the cause of the accident.

zh.t: 1992年尼日利亚空军C-130运输机空难
zh.s: 1992年9月26日，一架尼日利亚空军洛克希德C-130H“大力神”运输机从拉各斯起飞3分钟后坠毁，机上159人全部遇难，其中包括8名外国人。飞机当时以较高重量起飞，4台发动机中有3台失效。遇难者包括151名尼日利亚人、5名加纳人、1名坦桑尼亚人、1名津巴布韦人和1名乌干达军官。这是C-130“大力神”飞机死亡人数最多的空难。次年尼日利亚航空公司遭劫持也与这起事故有关，劫机者要求重新调查事故原因。

en.s: On 26 September 1994, a Yakovlev Yak-40, operated by Russian regional airliner Cheremshanka Airlines, crashed onto the bank of a river near Vanavara, Russia. All 24 passengers and 4 crew members died. The Russian investigation team concluded that pilot error was the cause of the crash. Poor weather conditions had required the flight to abort several landing attempts and the air crew failed to maintain awareness of the fuel quantity.

zh.s: 1994年9月26日，俄罗斯支线航空公司切列姆尚卡航空的一架雅克-40客机在俄罗斯瓦纳瓦拉附近坠入河岸。机上24名乘客和4名机组人员全部遇难。俄罗斯调查组认定事故原因为飞行员失误：天气不佳迫使飞机多次放弃着陆尝试，机组也未能及时掌握剩余燃油量。

en.s: Garuda Indonesia Flight 152 was a scheduled domestic flight operated by Garuda Indonesia from Soekarno–Hatta International Airport, Tangerang, Indonesia, to Polonia International Airport, Medan, Indonesia. On 26 September 1997, the Airbus A300 flying the route crashed into mountainous woodlands near the village of Buah Nabar, Sibolangit, killing all 222 passengers and 12 crew members on board. It is the deadliest aviation disaster in Indonesia's history, and the fourth-deadliest involving an Airbus A300.

zh.s: 印尼鹰航152号班机是一趟定期国内航班，从印度尼西亚丹格朗的苏加诺-哈达国际机场飞往棉兰的波洛尼亚国际机场。1997年9月26日，执行该航线的一架空客A300在锡博朗吉特布阿纳巴尔村附近的山地森林中坠毁，机上222名乘客和12名机组人员全部遇难。这是印度尼西亚死亡人数最多的空难，也是空客A300第四严重的空难。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Egypt on 26 September 1999. en.s: Hokkaido is the second-largest and northernmost of Japan's four main islands. en.s: Following the end of the 9-year terms of 127 "series C" senators, indirect senatorial elections were held in France on September 26, 2004. Since 2001, 10 seats had been added to Senate. This election elected Senators from 28 departments on the mainland (115 seats including 107 incumbents and 8 new seats), 2 from Guadeloupe and Martinique (5 seats including 4 incumbents and one new seat), 2 from overseas territories, Mayotte and Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (3 seats including 2 incumbents and one new seat), and 4 senators representing French citizens abroad.

en.s: The Battle of Al Rumaythah (26 September 2006) was fought during the morning in the Iraqi town of Al Rumaythah in Al Muthanna province between Australian forces of the Overwatch Battle Group (West) and unidentified Iraqi insurgents. en.s: The 2010 Philippine Bar exam bombing occurred on Taft Avenue near De La Salle University (DLSU), located in Malate, Manila, Philippines, on September 26, 2010, at 5:05 pm PST, a few minutes after Philippine Bar examinees began exiting DLSU. An Mk2 grenade was thrown at a group of Alpha Phi Beta members from San Beda College. They were standing near Tau Gamma Phi members, who police believed were the real target of the explosive. This resulted in injuries to 47 people, including two who required amputations. Jed Carlos Lazaga was initially accused of throwing the grenade, based on information received by the Manila Police District (MPD) from an unnamed witness.

en.s: The 68th San Sebastián International Film Festival took place from 18 to 26 September 2020 in San Sebastián, Gipuzkoa, Spain. The festival opened with Woody Allen's Rifkin's Festival. Viggo Mortensen was awarded the Donostia Award for lifetime achievements. The competitive awards were presented on 26 September 2020. Beginning by Dea Kulumbegashvili swept the official selection prizes, winning the Golden Shell, as well as Best Actress, Screenplay, and Director.

en.s: The 2021 Berlin state election, ruled invalid in 2022 and repeated in 2023, was held on 26 September 2021, on the same day as the 2021 German federal election, which also had to be repeated in parts of Berlin due to irregularities. Thus, the 19th Abgeordnetenhaus of Berlin was elected twice. The incumbent government was a red-red-green coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD), The Left, and The Greens led by Governing Mayor Michael Müller.

zh.s: 柏林于2021年9月26日举行州选举，与2021年德国联邦选举同日。2022年，该次州选举被裁定无效，并于2023年重选，因此柏林第19届众议院（州议会）选出了两次。时任政府由德国社会民主党（SPD）、左翼党和绿党组成“红红绿”联合执政联盟，执政市长为米夏埃尔·穆勒。

en.s: The 2021 Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election was held on 26 September 2021 to elect the 8th Landtag of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. The incumbent government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and Christian Democratic Union (CDU) led by Minister President Manuela Schwesig. The SPD won a landslide plurality of almost 40% of votes, a nine percentage point increase from 2016.

zh.t: 2021年梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州选举

en.s: A federal election was held in Germany on 26 September 2021 to elect the members of the 20th Bundestag. State elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern were also held. Incumbent chancellor Angela Merkel, first elected in 2005, chose not to run again, marking the first time that an incumbent Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany did not seek re-election.

zh.s: 德国于2021年9月26日举行联邦选举，选出第20届联邦议院议员。柏林和梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州同日举行州选举。现任总理安格拉·默克尔自2005年起担任总理，此次决定不再竞选连任。这是德意志联邦共和国历史上首次出现现任总理不寻求连任的情况。

en.s: Local elections in Portugal were held on 26 September 2021. The election consisted of three separate elections in the 308 Portuguese municipalities: the election for the Municipal Chamber (the executive branch of the municipality); another election for the Municipal Assembly (the deliberative branch of the municipality); and an election for the Parish Assembly (the deliberative branch of the lower-level parish), whose winner is elected parish president.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于2021年9月26日举行地方选举。全国308个市镇分别举行三类选举：选出负责行政事务的市政厅成员、负责审议事务的市议会成员，以及选出基层民区议会成员的选举；民区议会胜出者将出任民区主席。

en.s: The 2021 Lisbon local election was held on 26 September 2021 to elect the members of the Lisbon City Council. In a major upset, Carlos Moedas, the candidate of the centre-right New Times coalition led by the Social Democratic Party (PSD), was elected Mayor of Lisbon. The coalition managed to win with 34.3 percent of the votes and 7 councilors.

en.s: The 2021 Graz local election was held on 26 September 2021 to elect the members of the Gemeinderat of Graz. The Communist Party of Austria (KPÖ) became the largest party for the first time in the city's history, winning 29% of votes cast. The previous governing party, the Austrian People's Party (ÖVP), fell from 38% to second place with 26%.

en.s: The 2021 Upper Austrian state election was held on 26 September 2021 to elect the members of the Landtag of Upper Austria. The Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) remained the largest party with small gains. Of the six parties which won seats in the Landtag, the Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ) was the only one to suffer losses, falling from 31% of votes to 20%.

en.s: The 2021 Porto local election was held on 26 September 2021 to elect the members of the Porto City Council. As expected, Rui Moreira, mayor since 2013, won a third term as Mayor of Porto, despite losing his majority in the city council. He beat the Socialist candidate, Tiago Barbosa Ribeiro, who lost about 10% of the votes and 1 city councillor, and the Social Democratic candidate, Vladimiro Feliz, who despite an increase in his vote share failed to achieve the goal of surpassing the PS.

zh.s: 波尔图于2021年9月26日举行地方选举，选出市议会议员。自2013年起担任市长的鲁伊·莫雷拉如预期赢得第三个任期，但失去了市议会多数席位。他击败了社会党候选人蒂亚戈·巴博萨·里贝罗；后者得票率下降约10个百分点，并失去1个议席。社会民主党候选人弗拉迪米罗·费利斯虽然得票率上升，仍未能超过社会党。

en.t: Hurricane Helene makes landfall in Perry, Florida as a Category 4 hurricane, killing over 250 people, causing US$78.7 billion in damage and becoming the deadliest hurricane in the mainland United States since Katrina
en.s: Hurricane Helene ( heh-LEEN) was a powerful and devastating tropical cyclone that caused widespread catastrophic damage and numerous fatalities across the Southeastern United States in late September 2024. It was the strongest hurricane on record to strike the Big Bend region of Florida, the deadliest Atlantic hurricane since Hurricane Maria in 2017, and the deadliest to strike the mainland U.S. since Hurricane Katrina in 2005.

zh.t: 海伦妮飓风以4级强度在佛罗里达州佩里登陆，造成250多人死亡和787亿美元损失
zh.s: 海伦妮飓风是2024年9月下旬袭击美国东南部的一场强大且破坏性极强的热带气旋，造成大范围灾难性损失和大量人员伤亡。它是有记录以来登陆佛罗里达州大弯地区的最强飓风，是2017年玛丽亚飓风以来死亡人数最多的大西洋飓风，也是2005年卡特里娜飓风以来袭击美国本土的最致命飓风。

en.s: DMZ International Documentary Film Festival (Korean: DMZ국제다큐멘터리영화제), also known as DMZ Docs, is a South Korean film festival for documentary films jointly presented by Gyeonggi Province, Paju and Goyang.
